title: serve points at the wrong local port: blocked, from the serve status target (never from the listener shape)
titleZh: serve 指向了错误的本地端口:按 serve status 的目标端口判 blocked(绝不靠监听形状)
why: defensive-spec section 7 case 10, as corrected in t23 after the t22 experiment. The tailnet LISTENER SHAPE carries no information: every connected node has tailscaled-owned tailnet listeners (peerapi / WireGuard side - measured on the reference machine as 33588 and the fd7a:...:56868 endpoint, with nothing published on 443), so judging blocked from a non-443 tailscaled listener misreports a healthy machine. The only real evidence about where serve points is the proxy TARGET port inside a readable 'tailscale serve status'. Here it is readable and names 127.0.0.1:43120 while the measured DSH port is 49999: the remote UI would proxy to a dead port, and the narrow ACL (client -> server tcp:443) silently stops matching. Its negative control is fault-serve-moved-port-8443: the SAME netstat shape with a CORRECT serve target stays unknown, never blocked.
inject: a readable 'tailscale serve status' whose proxy target is 127.0.0.1:43120 while the DSH port is 49999 (netstat still carries a tailscaled 8443 row and no 443)
expectSummary: SERVE_PRESENT blocked/serve_port_mismatch with command + rollback, never pass/degraded/unknown, exit != 0
